title: Components are pure, like math formulas

slides.say: Think of y equals two x. If x is two, y is four. Always. React components should work the same way.

slides.text: A pure function minds its own business, and same inputs give the same output.
slides.say: A pure function does two things. It minds its own business, changing nothing that existed before. And the same inputs always give the same output.
This recipe only calculates from its props. Two drinkers? Always the same JSX.

slides.text: Props, state and context are inputs. Read them, never change them.
slides.say: While rendering, you can read three inputs: props, state, and context. Treat them as read only.
